milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The hay_block stack is at (8,1,3) relative to spawn (~8.5 blocks from origin). max_distance=6 requires the player to walk at least 2-3 blocks east from spawn to get within range. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the hay blocks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potato farm center is at (8,0,7) relative to spawn (~10.6 blocks from origin). max_distance=8 requires the player to walk southeast toward the farm area past the hay barn.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The lever is at (6,1,3) on the barn wall (~6.7 blocks from origin). max_distance=5 ensures the player approaches close enough to notice the adjacent fence gate with string storage behind it.

Uses inventory_has because mining acacia_wood (the bark-on-all-sides log variant) drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 acacia_wood, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining. Diamond axe is provided in the scene.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gray_wall_banner is at (-9,2,-3) on the exterior north face of the west building (attached to the stone_brick_wall at (-9,2,-2)). max_distance=8 requires walking west toward the building. Banner is at y=2 (eye level), easily visible when approaching from the north.

Uses inventory_has because mining a stone_brick_wall block with a pickaxe drops the stone_brick_wall item into the player's inventory. Diamond pickaxe is provided. The player starts with 0 stone_brick_wall so having ≥1 confirms successful mining from the west building.

Uses inventory_has because breaking a jungle_door (either half) drops 1 jungle_door item into the player's inventory. Any tool works; diamond axe is provided for speed. The player starts with 0 jungle_door so having ≥1 confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because crafting white_wool (4 string in a 2x2 pattern) produces 1 white_wool that ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 white_wool and must collect 4 string from the chest behind the fence gate, then craft. Having ≥1 white_wool confirms successful crafting.
